player_prompt.intro:
Ngwe wena Mdlali {player_id} ku Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Isikhala sakho si '{symbol}', futsi ema namba yakho ya ku hamba njalo {parity} (njengoba, X1, X3 noma O2, O4).

Inhloso: Wina ngokwakha umgca wa tikhala tingu-3 tinzima (ezisolidified kusuka kuma superpositions).

Indlela yokudlala:
- Kusukela kwa iladi, beka isikhala sesihlangu endaweni mbili ehlukile ezingakali ngendlela '[a,b]'.
- Lezi zikhala zisesihlangu zinahlanganiswe, futsi zibhalwe njenga 'X1 / X1' noma 'O4 / O4'.
- Awukwati ku beka izikhala zisesihlangu endaweni leyo eyasolidified.

Umthetho wokwehluka:
- Uma ku hamba kwakho kudala ingxenye kwenye grafu yehlanganiso, iwehluka ngokwazo.
- Isikhala sesihlangu kwenye ingxenye isuke isikhala sesolidified kwenye indawo yayo yinye.
- Izikhala zisesihlangu ezihlanganiswe nazo zikwehluka.

Inhloso:
- Umsebenzi udla ngani mdlali anetikhala tinzima tingu-3 mfula.
- Uma bomdlali laba baphumelela kuwehluka kwenye iladi leyo, lowo anenamba ndla ya ku hamba edla.

Isibonelo sekudlala: '[0,4]' ibeka isikhala sesihlangu kwenye izikhala 0 na 4.

invalid_move.invalid_cells: Ema-index etinhlayiya langasebenti nobe laphindvwe kabili.

game_action.placed: Mdlali {player_id} wathatha isithombe sakhe kwenqwaba elinganiselwe kwizindawo {pos_a} na {pos_b}.

game_message.last_cell_resolved: Inqwaba elinganiselwe yeceli elingapheli ihlelwe. Iceli ({r}, {c}) manje {symbol}.
